source.title: Zero Trust Microsegmentation Guidance
source.applicability: General zero trust microsegmentation controls including firewalls and ACLs

passages.text: Microsegmentation is a foundational Zero Trust strategy that enforces explicit, fine-grained communication controls between systems. By reducing unnecessary reachability, it aids with lateral movement prevention, contains threats, and minimizes blast radius.

Boundaries may be expressed through zones, routes, VLANs/VXLANs, security groups, labels, tags, Kubernetes network policies, host controls, hypervisor controls, firewalls, gateways, or other enforcement points. This model is often strongest for deterministic containment, local east-west control, regulatory boundaries, and OT/ICS zones and conduits.
